title: I made a Football Roguelite
author: lucasmonn
selftext: [Joga Bonito](https://jogabonito.gg) is a roguelite built around 7-a-side football. You draft a squad, pick upgrades and playstyles card by card, and climb a ladder of increasingly brutal matches before your build collapses. Pixel art visuals, deckbuilding mechanics grafted onto soccer (set pieces, powers, passives, post-win upgrade cards), bosses with their own curses/modifiers, and a fully deterministic match engine (same score every time a replay/server re-simulates it). It also has PvP (live duels and an async "ghost" attack mode) and season-based progression.
